preconditions.description: The number of tree nodes n is odd and within the range [3, 100000).
The number of search keys k is within the range [1, 100000].

preconditions.expression: all(0 < key <= 10**9 for _, key in nodes)
preconditions.description: All node keys are positive integers not exceeding 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(0 < key <= 10**9 for key in search_keys)
preconditions.description: All search keys are positive integers not exceeding 10^9.
The number of node descriptions matches the given number of nodes n.
The number of search keys matches the given number of keys k.

preconditions.expression: all(parent != i for i, (parent, _) in enumerate(nodes))
preconditions.description: No node is its own parent.

preconditions.expression: sum(1 for parent, _ in nodes if parent == -1) == 1
preconditions.description: There is exactly one root node (parent == -1).

preconditions.expression: len(set(key for _, key in nodes).union(set(search_keys))) == n + k
preconditions.description: All node keys and search keys are distinct.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly k real numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(value, float) for value in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is a real number.

postconditions.expression: all(0 < value <= 10**9 for value in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is a positive real number not exceeding 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(value - expected) <= 10**-9 for value, expected in zip(output, expected_values))
postconditions.description: Each output value differs from the expected value with an absolute or relative error not exceeding 10^-9.
